period_note: Year-end position for Social Islami Bank Limited, Solo/Standalone basis (reporting_basis determined by matching this dataset's stored figures against the bank's own Solo-labeled Balance Sheet / 'Only Bank-Solo Basis' Highlights annexure / Note 16.5 'Capital Adequacy (Solo Basis)', as distinct from the parallel Consolidated Balance Sheet covering SIBL and its two wholly-owned subsidiaries, SIBL Securities Limited and SIBL Investment Limited). Shariah-based Islamic bank: 'Investments (General)' is the Shariah-compliant equivalent of conventional Loans and Advances, and 'Classified Investments' / 'Ratio of Classified Investments to Total Investments' is the equivalent of NPL / NPL ratio -- mapped to this dataset's gross_loans and npl_pct fields for cross-bank comparability, consistent with the convention already used for EXIMBANK, FIRSTSBANK and GIB in this dataset. Source: own Balance Sheet (Solo) lines ~12072-12140; own Profit and Loss Account (Solo) lines ~12195-12240; own quarterly Basel III comparative table ('Total Regulatory Capital', 31-12-16 column) lines ~8803-8825.

line_items.metric_note: Islamic bank convention: 'Investments (General)' is SIBL's Shariah-compliant equivalent of conventional Loans and Advances.

line_items.original_metric_name: Total Off Balance Sheet Items including Contingent Liabilities
Tier-I Capital (Core Capital / Going Concern Capital)
Tier-II Capital (Supplementary Capital / Gone Concern Capital)
Total Capital (Tier I + Tier II) / Capital Base
Capital to Risk Weighted Asset Ratio (CRAR)

line_items.metric_note: Calculated as the reported classified-investment ratio x Investments (General); this year's own source tables report only the ratio, not the absolute Taka amount. Methodology validated: applying the identical ratio x gross-investment calculation to FY2017/FY2018 (where both the ratio AND the directly-reported absolute amount are available) reproduces the reported absolute figure to within 0.01 percentage points.

line_items.original_metric_name: Ratio of Classified Investments to Total Investments

line_items.metric_note: Calculated as Profit after Tax / average of period-start and period-end Total Shareholders' Equity (and, for ROA, / average Total Assets); this bank's own summary tables do not report ROA/ROE for this year (the 'Highlights of Performance' annexure only appears from FY2017 onward).

SIBL's own 'Investment-Deposit (ID) Ratio' / 'Investments as a % of Client Deposits' as reported; the bank's exact internal denominator basis is not fully disclosed and was not independently re-derived.
